_meta.purpose: Local inventory of Zoho Billing (Subscriptions) notification/workflow configuration, pulled via the Zoho Billing MCP connector for local review before being pushed back to the application.
_meta.source: Zoho Billing API - Email Alerts (Workflows) endpoint, Email Alert Execution History endpoint
known_gaps: Zoho Billing's standard, built-in transactional email notifications (e.g. Invoice Sent/Overdue reminders, Payment Received/Failed/Refunded, Subscription trial-ending/dunning/renewal reminders, Credit Note, Quote) are configured under Settings > Automation > Email Notifications per module and are NOT exposed for read via the connected MCP tools (no list/get endpoint for per-module default notification templates was available). Only custom Workflow-based alerts (Settings > Automation > Workflows) are readable via the 'List all Email Alerts' API, and are recorded below.

No 'list products' tool is exposed either, so per-product email template/recipient overrides (settable via the 'Update Product Email Templates' API) could not be enumerated - that endpoint is write-only from this connector and requires a product_id we don't have a way to look up.
Email alert execution history for the last 3 months (2026-05-01 to 2026-08-18) returned zero entries - none of the workflows below have fired/sent anything recently.

workflow_alerts.review_notes: Currently inactive. Description explicitly says 'Do Not Modify - Ashish'. Confirm with Ashish/owning team before changing; overlaps in trigger events with the active 'FullEvent' workflow below.

workflow_alerts.review_notes: Only currently-active workflow alert in the org. Also marked 'Do Not Modify - Ashish'. Zero executions recorded in the last 3 months per alert history, which is worth confirming with Ashish - could mean no matching events occurred, or the webhook endpoint/integration is stale.

recommended_review_actions: Decide whether the org needs the standard built-in email notifications (payment receipts, invoice reminders, dunning, subscription renewal/expiry emails) reviewed manually in the Zoho Billing UI (Settings > Automation > Email Notifications), since those aren't visible via API - this inventory only covers custom Workflow alerts.
Confirm with Ashish (or current owner) whether 'ADYTrainingManagement' and 'unpaid to live' workflows are still needed, or can be deleted/reactivated.
Investigate why 'FullEvent' (the only active workflow) shows zero execution history in the last 3 months - verify the webhook destination is still valid.

None of the 3 existing workflows send email (all action_type = webhook) - if the org expects email notifications for subscription lifecycle events, none currently exist; a new email-type alert would need to be created via 'Create an Email Alert'.

No alerts exist for Invoice, Customer, Credit Note, Payment, or Quote entities via the Workflow/Alert API - confirm whether that's intentional or whether equivalent behavior is expected to be covered by the (unreadable) standard per-module notifications.
